name: cache-autocompact
description: Runs /compact on its own when a big chat's prompt cache is about to lapse, so coming back after a break rereads a short summary instead of the whole chat at full price. Fires in the last minutes of the cache window, says so with a toast every time, says so again if the compact fails, and shows what it will do in the status line. Counts the cache down the same way prompt-cache-control does.

minTokens.title: Smallest chat to compact
minTokens.description: Prompt size in tokens below which a lapsing cache is left alone

windowSeconds.title: Compact this close to expiry (s)
windowSeconds.description: Seconds left on the cache countdown at which the compact fires. It is at most half the cache: 120 on a 5-minute cache, 1800 on a 1-hour cache. It never fires within a minute of a reply ending

skipPaths.title: Folders to leave alone
skipPaths.description: Comma-separated absolute folders it never compacts in, folders below them included; a folder that cannot be found turns it off and the status line names it. Empty means it runs everywhere
